prompt: Use case: logo-brand refinement. Edit target is the attached simple indigo/cyan orbital 3-node logo. The client accepts this minimal galaxy + knowledge nodes + abstract nebula direction, but rejects the aesthetic quality of the curves. Produce ONE substantially more refined professionally drawn logo, keeping the same restrained blue/periwinkle/cyan palette, transparent background, symbol only and small-size legibility. Redesign the orbital line rather than merely recoloring: replace the rigid heavy closed ellipse with two elegantly balanced OPEN sweeping arcs with intentional rhythmic width variation, immaculate smooth curvature and softly tapered but robust ends. Suggest a flowing spiral galaxy around a single smaller central knowledge node. Two satellite nodes at the arc terminals, connected organically with optically considered spacing; three nodes maximum. Avoid oversized blob-like dots. Clear airy negative space, gentle asymmetry, sophisticated confident silhouette and graceful motion, not a generic atom/science icon. The arcs should feel drawn by an expert identity designer with geometric discipline, not rough brushwork. No additional rings, crossings, network meshes, fine strands, sparkle stars, tiny dots, fine texture, glow, drop shadow, 3D, lettering or background. Flat solid color shapes, no mottling or gritty edges. The exact drawing can change to improve craft, but simplicity and theme must remain. Make every remaining shape meaningful at 24-48px. One centered standalone logo on true alpha transparency; no mockup, no board, no variations sheet.
